item.title: World Cup 2026: France v Spain semi-final buildup; Rice set to start for England against Argentina – live
item.description:
Unstoppable Force Meets Immovable Object: France and Spain Gear Up for Semi-Final Showdown

As the world’s top four ranked teams prepare to face off in the World Cup semi-finals, the stage is set for a clash for the ages. France, with their freewheeling attack, will take on the stingy Spanish defense, in what promises to be a battle for the ages. The stakes are high, with both teams eager to secure a spot in the final and claim the coveted World Cup title.
